title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: An agent's fixed part (system prompt and tool definitions) plus conversation so far makes the input to its third model call 4,000 tokens. The model replies with a tool request of 100 tokens, and the tool returns a result of 500 tokens. The program appends both to the message list and calls the model again. How many input tokens does the fourth call have?
A student says in a brand-new chat, "Book the same slot as last week." The makerspace assistant answers correctly. Which of these must have happened for it to know what "last week" means?

options.text: The model kept its memory of the earlier visit between sessions
The old session's message list was still stored in the window
The program loaded the student's saved notes into the new session
The model's window is large enough to hold last week's chat

items.stem: The assistant's saved notes for a student named Priya say "band saw training complete." Today Priya says she finished the training and asks to book the band saw. What should the assistant do before booking?

options.text: Call the training tool now and decide from the record it returns
Book it, because the saved note says she completed the training
Book it, because Priya says she finished it and sounds certain
Book it, because the model judges that she seems experienced

items.stem: In one sentence, why does retrieving the five most relevant chunks of a 120-page manual usually cost less per request than pasting the whole manual into the prompt?
In a retrieval system, the query's embedding is the vector (5, 12) and one manual chunk's embedding is the vector (12, 5). What is their cosine similarity, to two decimal places?
